Last user utterance: I want to get a mobile phone for my business service

Your response: I want to get a mobile phone 

Example 2: 
Last user utterance: I got questions about business mobility services
Your response: I got questions about mobility services

Example 3: 
Last user utterance: Do you accept trade-ins for business bought phones? 

Your response: Do you accept trade-ins for phones?
